notes: INSIDE half of the Breach Harpoon (unique, gold trim): the cable spool, which winds the rope back on as it charges (rope disc grows frame by frame, frame 5 = full, strip green; the spokes turn half a step on odd frames), power coupling, repair hatch. fire: the spool is empty and the strip discharges. damaged: spool flange cracked, rope fraying, sparks; disabled: spool jammed and dark, rope tangled. Barrel layer breach_harpoon_barrel: the heavy open trough with the harpoon (barbed head) loaded; fire: the harpoon flies, the cable pays out, steam.
